model_scope: Accepted solver RLIB/mimalloc/Spot/Solver/GpuPlan CPU build, fresh process per arm, original reg0/reg1/strat0/strat1 exact predicates copied verbatim. No GPU/context/pinned buffer/device allocation. Model is not the production upload function; layout fresh snapshot guards are trivially true and private ArenaLayout construction is not reproduced.
proposed_mechanism: For Windows quantized stores with total q payload >=64MiB and every scale positive-zero, hint all4 owned q ranges once, then execute all4 original validation scans. No cached provenance, skipped/reordered q scan, parallel OR, SIMD helper, initialization omission or source activation. Threshold64MiB is fixed before first native observation and cannot be tuned after failure. Tiny cases fall back before scale precheck; additional eligibility work stays inside component clock.
limits: Source is an isolated component prototype. Counters describe whole process and cannot isolate hard faults or physical-cache allocation. Prefetch and extra eligibility/timer overhead included. No no-tradeoff or complete-cycle claim.
